# Johan Burisch

Johan Burisch is a senior medical leader at [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] serving on the steering committee of [[danibd|DANIBD]], Denmark's national database for inflammatory bowel disease. Between 2023 and 2024, his professional title advanced from Afdelingslæge (Department Head) to Overlæge (Chief Physician), reflecting increased seniority within the region's medical hierarchy. Throughout this period, he maintained his credentials as dr.med. ph.d. and, as of 2024, holds the title of professor [^src1][^src2].

Burisch's involvement with DANIBD places him at the center of Denmark's coordinated effort to track and manage inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) across all five regions. The database, which covers patients treated at public Danish hospitals, recorded 33,381 IBD patients between October 2022 and September 2023, with Region Hovedstaden treating the largest patient volume [^src3]. The DANIBD steering committee, of which Burisch is a member, comprises physicians, surgeons, nurses, patient representatives, and epidemiological support staff from across the country, ensuring that clinical expertise at the regional level — including Burisch's — informs national IBD treatment standards and data quality [^src3].
